result.title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
result.summary: Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data. We ask whether a model needs to hear the audio directly at all, and present SleuthVLM, an agent harness built on a VLM that never hears the audio directly: speech will be transcribed into text, and the VLM will sleuth the video on its own without any predefined workflow. On four omni benchmarks with videos up to 90 minutes, SleuthVLM achieves the best average accuracy: \textbf{75.0%}, 2.6 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash, and it also tops the Video-MME-v2 leaderboard with \textbf{77.8%}; with an open-source 27B VLM, it beats all open-source omni models. We draw three findings: SleuthVLM beats a model that glances; hearing is not the bottleneck, agentic ability is; omni understanding needs better agentic ability, not just more omni data for modality alignment. So we provide a simple but effective starting point for doing omni video understanding. Omni understanding needs better agents, not just bigger models that hear.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SleuthVLM：先把视频音频转写为文本，再让 VLM 在没有预设流程的情况下自主「侦查」长视频（最长 90 分钟），在四个 omni 基准上取得 75.0% 平均成绩，并据此主张瓶颈不是「听见音频」而是 agentic 能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作涉及长视频中自主获取视觉证据与何时停止的决策，其「模态对齐不如 agent 能力关键」的诊断可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中证据筛选与工作区设计的收益来源；但状态完全在文本轨迹中、无 latent 表示，机制联系需读原文确认。
